about: Real captures used on the marketing site: the Galley app (public/screens/) and the Caddow example site itself (public/sites/). Every one comes from scripts/capture-screens.mjs, run against a live Galley with a throwaway copy of the fashion starter (astro-editorial, “Caddow”) — and, for the WordPress move, a second throwaway copy (astro-starter, “Lowfield Studio”) importing the importer's invented WordPress site. 1440 × 900 window at 2× device scale, light theme, WebP, with a 1× copy (<name>@1x.webp). Each is shown on the site at half its pixel width.
setup: From the repository root: pnpm --filter @galley/web exec vite build --outDir /tmp/galley-site3/web --emptyOutDir
Server with the assistant (one request, the 'assistant' step): /tmp/galley-verify/keyed-server.sh 4722 /tmp/galley-site3/caddow /tmp/galley-site3/home /tmp/galley-site3/web <token>
Open the second site: POST /api/sites/open {"path":"/tmp/galley-site3/lowfield"}; site ids: GET /api/sites (Authorization: Bearer <token>)
The importer's stand-in WordPress site: (packages/import-wordpress) node --import tsx test/serve-fake-site.ts --port 4723
command: GALLEY_ORIGIN=http://127.0.0.1:4722 GALLEY_TOKEN=<token> GALLEY_SITE=<caddow id> SITE_DIR=/tmp/galley-site3/caddow WP_SITE=<lowfield id> WP_URL=http://127.0.0.1:4723 PLAYWRIGHT_MODULES=<node_modules with playwright-core> node scripts/capture-screens.mjs reset site looks arrange drag click assistant chat form proof source wordpress

notes: The site captures are taken from the starter's own dev server, not the preview proxy (which answers only inside the app); the dev toolbar is hidden in every capture.

On 2026-11-23 the vendored kit's dev HTML hook in every starter (src/galley/visibility/integration.js, interceptHtml) turned Astro's Uint8Array chunks into comma-separated numbers, so `astro dev` and Galley's preview showed digits instead of the page. The throwaway copies were patched (Buffer.from(chunk) for Uint8Array) for these captures; the kit and the starters need the same fix.
The recording is WebM (VP9) only. Browsers that can't play it show the poster.
Agent files are not captures: the /ai-first/ page shows this site's own files, read at build time.
